kneeCare.title: Knee care
kneeCare.body: Keep knees tracking over toes, no bouncing, pain-free range only. Any sharp knee pain — tap swap on that exercise for a gentler alternative. Ice 10 min after if achy.

plan.description: The 6-phase plan, weekly split, and nutrition targets behind your program.

goal.title: The goal, honestly
goal.honest: Losing ~{{loss}} kg ({{start}} → {{goal}}) over {{days}} days is about {{rate}} kg/week — a safe, sustainable pace. The plan is built to lose fat while keeping muscle, so you look leaner rather than just lighter — that's why protein and resistance training matter more than cardio here.

items: Flatter stomach / slimmer waist — ~90% nutrition. The calorie deficit does this; there's no ab exercise that "burns" belly fat.
Leaner chest — the same deficit, with DB floor press and push work keeping the muscle underneath firm as fat drops.
Shoulder definition — DB shoulder press and lateral raises in your full-body sessions, progressed over time (log your sets so the weight climbs).
Overall fitter look — consistency across the 3 weekly full-body sessions plus 7–10k steps every day.

goal.stepsTip: Now on a 3-day full-body split (Mon/Wed/Fri) with 7,000–10,000 steps every day — more recovery between lifts, and the daily steps are your biggest lever for central fat. Completely knee-safe.

nutrition.title: Nutrition targets

nutrition.goalHint: Recalculated automatically whenever you log a new weight. Starting {{start}} kg, goal {{goal}} kg.

kneeRules.title: Knee rules (read once, follow always)
items: Knees track over toes, never caving inward.
Only move through a pain-free range — shallow is fine, especially on wall sits and goblet squats.
No bouncing or jumping anywhere in the program.
Sharp pain = stop that movement, swap the marked alternative, keep going.
Warm up every session (the timer includes it) and ice 10 minutes after if the knee feels achy.
If pain worsens or persists beyond a couple of weeks, see a physiotherapist.
